why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (convenient, dense drugstores run on profit per customer visit) and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 1 explicitly rejects profit per store, commits more firmly to exiting restaurants and discount stores with a deadline, and handles the LIFO adjustment more carefully. Analysis 2 has a tighter verdict but leans on a per-store hurdle, only says "explore exiting" the discount stores, and overclaims that nobody measures unit economics when the dossier only says the data is absent.
